verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              एवं विलपतस्तस्य श्रुत्वा तु करुणं वचः । गृहीता शकुनिघ्नेन कपोती वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥१॥
verses.english: Yajnavalkya said You have asked me, O king, of that Supreme Brahma which lives in the Unmanifest. Your question relates to a deep mystery. Listen to me with rapt attention, O king.

verses.sanskrit: कपोत्युवाच । अहोऽतीव सुभाग्याहं यस्या मे दयितः पतिः । असतो वा सतो वापि गुणानेवं प्रभाषते ॥२॥
verses.english: Having behaved humbly according to the ordinances laid down by the Rishis I obtained the Yajushes, O king, from the Sun-god.

verses.sanskrit: न सा स्त्री ह्यभिमन्तव्या यस्यां भर्ता न तुष्यति । तुष्टे भर्तरि नारीणां तुष्टाः स्युः सर्वदेवताः । अग्निसाक्षिकमित्येव भर्ता वै दैवतं परम् । दावाग्निनेव निर्दग्धा सपुष्पस्तवका लता ॥३॥
verses.english: With the hardest penances i formerly adored the heat-giving god. O sinless one, pleased with me, the powerful Sun, addressed me, saying, O regenerate Rishi, pray for the boon you covet, however difficult it may be of acquisition. I shall, with cheerful mind, grant it to you. It is very difficult to make me grant grace.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मीभवति सा नारी यस्या भर्ता न तुष्यति ॥४॥
verses.english: Bowing to him with my head, I addressed that foremost of heat-giving luminaries thus, I have no knowledge of the Yajushes. I wish to know them forthwith.

verses.sanskrit: इति संचिन्त्य दुःखार्ता भर्तारं दुःखितं तदा । कपोती लुब्धकेनापि गृहीता वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥५॥
verses.english: The holy one, thus solicited, told ine,-I shall grant you the Yajushes. Made up of the essence of speech, the goddess of learning Sarasvati will enter into your person.

verses.sanskrit: हन्त वक्ष्यामि ते श्रेयः श्रुत्वा तु कुरु तत्तथा । शरणागतसंत्राता भव कान्त विशेषतः ॥६॥
verses.english: The god then ordered me to open my mouth. I did as I was cominanded. The goddess Sarasvati then entered into my body, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: एष शाकुनिकः शेते तव वासं समाश्रितः । शीतार्तश्च क्षुधार्तश्च पूजामस्मै समाचर॥७॥
verses.english: At this, I began to burn. Unable to suffer the pain I plunged into river. Not understanding what the great Sun had done for a me for my well-being, I became even angry with him.

verses.sanskrit: ये हि कश्चिद्द्विजं हन्यात् गां च लोकस्य मातरम् । शरणागतं च यो हन्यात् तुल्यं तेषां च पातकम् ॥८॥
verses.english: While I was burning with the energy of the goddess, the holy Sun told me.-Do you suffer this burning sensation for only a little time. That will soon come to an end and you will be cool.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं विहिता वृत्तिः कापोती जातिधर्मतः । सा न्याय्याऽत्मवता नित्यं त्वद्विधेनानुवर्तितुम् ॥९॥
verses.english: Indeed, I became cool. Beholding me restored to ease, the Maker of light said to me,-The whole Vedas, with its appendix, together with the Upanishads, will appear in you by inward light, О twice-born one.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु धर्मं यथाशक्ति गृहस्थो ह्यनुवर्तते । स प्रेत्य लभते लोकानक्षयानिति शुश्रुम ॥१०॥
verses.english: You will also edit the entire Satapathas, O foremost of twice-born ones. After that, your understanding will turn to the path of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं सन्तानवानद्य पुत्रवानसि च द्विज । तत्स्वदेहे दयां त्यक्त्वा धर्मार्थौ परिगृह्य च । पूजामस्मै प्रयुंक्ष्व त्वं प्रीयेतास्य मनो यथा ॥११॥
verses.english: You will also acquire that end which is desirable and which is coveted by both Sankhyas and Yogins. Having said so, the divine Sun proceeded to the setting hills.

verses.sanskrit: मत्कृते मा च संतापं कुर्वीथास्त्वं विहङ्गम । शरीरयात्राकृत्यर्थमन्यान् दारानुपैष्यसि ॥१२॥
verses.english: Hearing his last words, and after he had departed from where I was, I came home in joy and then remembered the goddess Sarasvati.

verses.sanskrit: इति सा शकुनी वाक्यं पञ्जरस्था तपस्विनी । अतिदुःखान्विता प्रोक्त्वा भर्तारं समुदैक्षत ॥१३॥
verses.english: Thought of by me, the auspicious Sarasvati appeared immediately before my eyes, adorned with all the vowels and the consonants and having placed the syllable OM in the van.
